Services

End-to-end drafting and design for overhead and underground distribution networks.

01

Overhead Distribution Design

Pole and wire modeling with full OH profile modeling — conductor sizing, span layout, structure placement and pole replacements, drafted in CATAN and Poles'n'Wires.

02

Underground Cable Drafting

Cable sizing and rating with LV drop and cable pull calculations, plus routing, trench plans and cross-sections for clean underground installations.

03

As-Built Updates & Staging Plans

Field-verified as-built revisions and construction staging plans, delivered on budget and on time.

Portfolio

Selected work delivered across Tasmania and interstate — overhead, underground, substation and public lighting projects.

Rural 11kV Reconductoring

10 km HV rebuild — pole replacements, OH/LV restringing and full pole & wire profile modeling

105-Lot Underground Subdivision

22kV HV & LV reticulation — cable sizing, rating and LV drop calcs, kiosk substations, staged delivery

Substation Install, Upgrade & Replacement

Decommissioning, new KIOSK substation, earthing assessment and touch voltage analysis

Experience & Expertise

Over six years drafting and designing distribution systems, with hands-on familiarity of the Tasmanian network and its operators — including Western Power and TasNetworks drafting conventions, and designs to AS/NZS 3000, AS/NZS 3010 and AS 2067.
